snippet.title: The Spotter: Dig or Die - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Dig by day and fight to survive by night. Here's your look at gameplay in the announcement trailer for The Spotter: Dig or Die, an upcoming game that is a blend of mining and Tower Defense. As the last Spotter at a ruined gas station, hold back mutant hordes, scavenge the wasteland, and repair your receiver to capture the President’s vital message — humanity’s last hope. The Spotter: Dig or Die will be available on PC in 2025.
